name: stopifnot
title: Stop at the first name that is not TRUE

origin.description: Named arguments are checked in order. The error message is the name.
origin.details: The value must be logical, with no NA, and every element TRUE. The first failure wins. Success returns nothing.
origin.value: The error message, or null when every check passes.
origin.example:
bp_stopifnot <- getFromNamespace("stopifnot", "backports")
print(tryCatch(bp_stopifnot("Test" = 1 == 2), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)))
bp_stopifnot("Test" = 1 == 1)
cat("ok\n")
